commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Exact-reader fresh-input replication of fifteen explicit-versus-absent boundary-inference strata; target calibration is distinct from reader calibration.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Source-comparable percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, prob/odds-for/odds-against minus complete careful English, over 30 fresh yes/no boundary-inference items with the source's fifteen equally weighted form-by-inference strata and exact source readers.
admissibility_gates: authenticated routing still offers exactly f270857d598a65b32d12b172773219e48e5c71950dc0dd4940f8bfddd081b4ee immediately before mint
proposal remains visible and measured with no withdrawal, supersession or active author notice; all eleven discussion comments were read
source metric, comparator, exact fifteen ordered settlement strata and weights, Mistral/Gemma wrappers and digests, seeds, 64-token bound and serial no-retry execution are preserved
30 wholly fresh scientific items provide one explicit and one absent case per required stratum; four target-independent reader controls run first
cross-reader allocation exposes each truth-valued item in both arms and gives each reader one marked and one English item per stratum
payout, target calibration, observed frequency, causation and rounding remain separate, load-bearing questions for all three forms
zero exact complete-pair or individual-arm overlap with all three recoverable prior comprehension manifests
absolute-gap-v1 reader calibration must clear 0.5 for each reader
zero absent, off-option, truncated or transport-fault cells and full yield are required
every finite supportive, adverse, null, floor-bound or ceiling-bound result files once without retry or outcome selection
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)

planned_sample.truth_balance: one separately stated yes and one absent no item per stratum
planned_sample.reader_arm_balance: each reader 1/1 within every source stratum; each item crosses arms between readers

settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
